summary: Synthetic dealer workshop cases. The structure mirrors a production DA (Dealer Assistant) workshop planning system: one case object per workshop dossier, with its statuses, orders and workshop tasks attached. All values are invented.

files.da-cases.csv: One flattened row per case. Lists are joined with '|'. freitext can contain newlines, so read the file with a real CSV parser.
files.states.json: The workshop status vocabulary used by the cases.

case_fields.name: external_ref
case_fields.description: External reference, null in most cases.

case_fields.name: application_id
case_fields.description: Source application code of the case.

case_fields.name: canceled_at
case_fields.description: Set when the case was cancelled; the record stays.

case_fields.name: in_open_list
case_fields.description: Case still on the open worklist.

case_fields.name: license_plate
case_fields.description: Fictional plate, district codes that Germany never issues.

case_fields.name: vehicle_identification_number
case_fields.description: 17 characters, fictional WMI starting with ZZ, valid ISO 3779 check digit.

case_fields.name: company
case_fields.description: Company customer, empty string for private customers.

case_fields.name: first_name
case_fields.description: Contact first name, can be empty.

case_fields.name: last_name
case_fields.description: Contact last name, can be empty.

case_fields.name: email
case_fields.description: Contact email, null in roughly one case in five.

case_fields.name: note
case_fields.description: The workshop note as the source system stores it: HTML paragraphs, some carrying a dated author prefix span.

case_fields.name: freitext
case_fields.description: The same note as plain text, paragraphs separated by newlines. This is the field the challenge works on.

case_fields.name: states
case_fields.description: Current statuses of the case, resolved inline: id, name, category_id, category, is_done. The first entry is the general case status (category 4).

case_fields.name: statables
case_fields.description: Raw status rows: id, state_id, statable_id, statable_type, state_reason_id, changed_by, created_by, created_at, updated_at.

case_fields.name: orders
case_fields.description: Workshop orders: id, note, number, external_ref, gateway_ref, dossier_id, insurer_id, insurer_reference, auto_repair_manager_id, auto_repair_manager_reference, application_id, created_by, created_at, updated_at, order_type_id, is_sub_order, is_controlled, is_huk_relevant.

case_fields.name: workshop_tasks
case_fields.description: Planned workshop work: id, dossier_id, workshop_team_id, start_date, start_time, work_load, work_state, workshop_service_id, order_id, description. work_state: 1 in progress, 2 done, 3 new.

case_fields.name: ground_truth
case_fields.description: Synthetic labels behind the generated note: case_type (service or damage), case_kind, zones, severity, insurance_type, lifecycle_stage. Provided for scoring only. Reading it instead of the free text defeats the exercise.
